name: Schneider Electric CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Schneider Electric S.E. focuses on digital transformation in energy management and automation. It operates energy management, industrial automation and central functions segments, with energy built on the EcoStruxure technology offering and automation serving discrete, process and hybrid industries. Two Schneider founders started it in 1836, and it is based in Rueil-Malmaison, France.
